Name: HallowsEvePack
Description: Hallow's Eve, a yearly autumn event for any server running Ziggfreed's CommonLib. Each October, Old Jack opens the Forgotten Temple with a questline, dailies, Lantern Bombs, the Hallow King and the Hollow Crypt, all paid in Hallow Sweets. It plays on its own; MMO Skill Tree adds skill XP and set bonuses, and RPG Stations adds the Carving Bench.
